hook_text: Can a straight line be an angle? Sizwe says yes, and he can prove it on a skateboard.
clip_script: Skate park in Cape Town! Sizwe turns a quarter: right angle. A half turn: he faces back the way he came. That is a straight angle! All the way round: a revolution. Now the ramps. Gentle ramp: acute. Wide-open gate: obtuse. Turn three quarters: reflex! Six kinds of turn: acute, right, obtuse, straight, reflex, revolution. And longer arms? Same turn, same angle.
visual_style: Top-down skate park with a glowing arc tracing each turn of the skateboard, and a big clock showing matching angles.
mood: Cool and energetic, like a skate video.
pacing: Quick tricks, each one frozen with its angle name, then a fast recap.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and find a reflex angle in your classroom.
